title: After Comparing Every Covered Call Nasdaq-100 ETF These 3 Pay Up to 14 Percent Without Capping Your AI Upside
excerpt: Not all covered call ETFs on the Nasdaq-100 are built the same, and choosing the wrong one could mean sacrificing the AI rally you bought the index to captur...

Quick Read

  • QQQI pays a 14% yield using tax-efficient Section 1256 index options, while GPIQ writes calls on only 25-50% of notional to preserve AI upside.

  • QQQ returned 26% over the trailing year, and JEPQ's defensive stock sleeve and beta of 0.83 trade some of that AI upside for smoother drawdowns.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and GPIQ didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Covered call ETFs on the Nasdaq-100 have multiplied over the past three years, with newer entrants solving a problem that plagued early funds: delivering double-digit yields without capping the AI-driven appreciation that makes the index worth owning. Three funds stand out for balancing that trade in materially different ways. The JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF (NASDAQ:JEPQ), the NEOS Nasdaq-100® High Income ETF (NASDAQ:QQQI), and the Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Premium Income ETF (NASDAQ:GPIQ) each write calls against Nasdaq-100 exposure, yet produce distinct profiles for yield, tax treatment, and participation in a rally.

The underlying index matters because Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ:QQQ) has returned 26% over the trailing year, driven by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Alphabet holdings that dominate every fund on this list. A covered call strategy that caps too aggressively surrenders most of that. One that caps too little collects modest premium. The three ETFs sit at different points on that spectrum.

Why Covered Calls On The Nasdaq-100 Are Working Right Now

Covered call funds sell upside optionality for cash premium. When implied volatility is elevated, premiums fatten, and distributions rise. The CBOE Volatility Index sits at 17, slightly below its 12-month average of 18, after spiking to 31 in March. That mix of episodic fear and structural AI enthusiasm has kept Nasdaq-100 option premiums rich enough to fund monthly distributions ranging from roughly 10% to 14% annualized.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and GPIQ didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Fund design has changed in recent years. Rather than writing at-the-money calls on the full portfolio, newer funds write out-of-the-money calls on a slice of notional, use flexible strike selection, or rely on index options for tax treatment. Those choices allow the three funds below to quote yields near double digits while capturing a meaningful share of a bull market in mega-cap tech.

  • QQQ 去年的回报率为 26%，而 JEPQ 的防御性股票套筒和 0.83 的贝塔系数则用人工智能的部分优势换取了更平稳的回撤。
  • 立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 GPIQ 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

过去三年，纳斯达克 100 指数的备兑看涨 ETF 数量成倍增长，新进入者解决了困扰早期基金的问题：在不限制人工智能驱动的升值的情况下实现两位数的收益率，从而使该指数值得拥有。 三只基金在以截然不同的方式平衡贸易方面脱颖而出。 摩根大通纳斯达克股票溢价收入 ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：JEPQ）、NEOS Nasdaq-100® 高收入 ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：QQQI）和高盛 Nasdaq-100 溢价收入 ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：GPIQ）均针对 Nasdaq-100 风险敞口提出看涨期权，但在收益率、税收待遇和参与涨势方面产生了不同的概况。

基础指数很重要，因为 Invesco QQQ Trust（纳斯达克股票代码：QQQ）在 NVIDIA、微软和 Alphabet 持有的股票的推动下，过去一年的回报率为 26%，这些公司在名单上的每只基金中占据主导地位。 过于激进的持保看涨期权策略会放弃其中的大部分。 如果上限太低，则收取的溢价并不高。 这三只 ETF 处于不同的位置。

为什么纳斯达克 100 指数的备兑看涨期权现在有效

备兑看涨期权基金出售上行期权以获得现金溢价。 当隐含波动率升高时，溢价就会增加，分配也会增加。 CBOE 波动率指数在 3 月份飙升至 31 后，目前为 17，略低于 18 的 12 个月平均水平。 这种偶发性恐惧和结构性人工智能热情的结合，使纳斯达克 100 指数期权溢价足够丰厚，足以为年化约 10% 至 14% 的月度分配提供资金。

立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 GPIQ 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

近年来，基金设计发生了变化。 较新的基金不是对整个投资组合写出平值看涨期权，而是对一部分名义投资写出虚值看涨期权，使用灵活的执行选择，或依靠指数期权进行税务处理。 这些选择使得以下三只基金的收益率接近两位数，同时在大型科技股的牛市中占据了有意义的份额。
